# Generated by ppc finalize (construction_plan_country.py) from [construction_plan_country]; do not edit by hand.

# Prosper or Perish - Construction Plan, the Towns and Buildings tab (Jan 2026-11-10): building upgrades, public
# buildings, town and city upgrades and urban rights for the whole country. Run by pp_cplan_run
# (pp_construction_plan.txt), where scope:pp_cplan_country is the country and scope:actor the builder. Everything
# is off until the player ticks it.
# Country variables: pp_cplan_upgrade (the building upgrades), pp_cplan_pub_<building> (a ticked public building),
# pp_cplan_rank_town / _city (the town and city upgrades), pp_cplan_rights_on and pp_cplan_right_<right> (the urban
# rights rule and its ticked rights), pp_cplan_ctl / pp_cplan_tpop / pp_cplan_infl (the tab's lines, + 100; defaults
# in [construction_plan_country]), pp_cplan_rights_n (rights the last pass granted, + 100). Location, during a rule
# only: pp_cplan_up_try (the upgrade rule), pp_cplan_right_mark (the rights rule).
# The ledger is pp_construction_plan.txt's (construction code 107; pp_cplan_log_step 1 = a public
# building, 2 = a town or city upgrade, 3 = a building's upgrade).

# Country scope, inside pp_cplan_run: the gold rule group. The upgrades of standing buildings go first, then the
# public buildings, then the town and city upgrades (which hold a location's construction slot for a year or two).
# It pays from its purse like every rule group (pp_construction_plan.txt, "Budgets that save"): the first thing it
# wants and cannot pay for, a building or a town or city upgrade, is what it saves for, and it starts nothing more
# in the pass.
# Script time (2026-11-10): every rule walks all owned locations (the public buildings once per ticked building,
# the upgrades every building of every location), so each rule looks only in its own months ([construction_plan]
# look_months: pp_cplan_looks_upgrades / _public / _ranks), one rule a look. While the group saves for something
# it does not look at all: once its purse can pay, it goes back to that one location (pp_cplan_group_target,
# pp_cplan_country_target), and looks again from its next month on.
pp_cplan_group_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_country_w > 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_saving = { why = 107 } }
			pp_cplan_group_target = { why = 107 do = pp_cplan_country_target }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					pp_cplan_looks_upgrades = yes
					pp_cplan_looks_public = yes
					pp_cplan_looks_ranks = yes
				}
			}
			pp_cplan_group_start = { why = 107 }
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_looks_upgrades = yes }
				pp_cplan_country_upgrades = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_looks_public = yes }
				pp_cplan_country_buildings = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_looks_ranks = yes }
				pp_cplan_country_ranks = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope, for the console (pp_cplan_test_country, to time the group): its three rules in one look, whatever
# the month.
pp_cplan_look_country_all = {
	pp_cplan_group_start = { why = 107 }
	pp_cplan_country_upgrades = yes
	pp_cplan_country_buildings = yes
	pp_cplan_country_ranks = yes
}

# Location scope (pp_cplan_group_target: where the group saved for something, its purse can pay now): the town or
# city upgrade it saved for (scope:pp_cplan_trank 1 / 2) with that rule's gates, or one level of the building
# type it saved for (scope:pp_cplan_btype): the country's part of the can-build check, for a public building
# (scope:pp_cplan_rs = 1) the location's part too (an upgrade of a building does not ask it), and the
# construction goods in the market. Through the plan's one construct path, as at a look.
pp_cplan_country_target = {
	scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_save_rank_107 }
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_country_site = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_trank > 0.5 scope:pp_cplan_trank < 1.5 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
					modifier:cannot_upgrade_location = no
					pp_cplan_country_goods_town = yes
				}
				pp_cplan_country_rank_up = { rank = town n = 101 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_trank > 1.5 scope:pp_cplan_trank < 2.5 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					location_rank = location_rank:town
					modifier:cannot_upgrade_location = no
					pp_cplan_country_goods_city = yes
				}
				pp_cplan_country_rank_up = { rank = city n = 102 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = scope:pp_cplan_btype }
				OR = {
					scope:pp_cplan_rs > 1.5
					can_build_building = scope:pp_cplan_btype
				}
			}
			pp_cplan_btype_data = yes
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_cplan_gok > 0.5 }
				scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_noted }
				pp_cplan_construct_scoped = { why = 107 }
			}
			else = {
				pp_cplan_note_goods = { why = 107 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- Upgrade buildings ----

# Country scope, while the rule is on: every owned location the group may build in (pp_cplan_country_site: a free
# construction slot among the rest) with a building the country can upgrade, the highest control first: one upgrade
# a location a month.
pp_cplan_country_upgrades = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_upgrade }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				pp_cplan_country_site = yes
				any_buildings_in_location = { pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes }
			}
			order_by = pp_cplan_country_control_here
			max = 100000
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = pp_cplan_up_site
			# the window: the location's maximum control in % (+ 100); an upgrade of a building
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_rv value = { value = max_control multiply = 100 add = 100 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_rs value = 3 }
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_noted }
			every_buildings_in_location = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_country_upgradable = yes }
				pp_cplan_country_upgrade_building = yes
			}
			remove_variable = pp_cplan_up_try
		}
	}
}

# Building scope (an upgradable building of scope:pp_cplan_up_site), while no upgrade was tried there this month: its
# direct successor (the type that names it with obsolete = <older tier>; where several do, the first in the game's
# file order the country can build), when the country's part of the can-build check passes for it. The location's
# part is not asked: the game's upgrade does not need it (it is what refuses a new building of an older tier).
pp_cplan_country_upgrade_building = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { has_variable = pp_cplan_up_try } } }
		if = {
			limit = { building_type = building_type:coastal_fort scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = building_type:naval_battery } }
			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = naval_battery demand = fort_construction } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_type = building_type:early_council_hall scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = building_type:council_hall } }
			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = council_hall demand = town_building_construction } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_type = building_type:council_hall scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = building_type:modern_council_hall } }

			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = public_kitchen demand = workshop_construction } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_type = building_type:cinnabar_pit scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = building_type:quicksilver_retort } }
			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = quicksilver_retort demand = workshop_construction } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_type = building_type:rice_farm scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = building_type:rice_farmstead } }
			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = rice_farmstead demand = workshop_construction } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_type = building_type:rice_farmstead scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = building_type:rice_rotations } }
			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = rice_rotations demand = workshop_construction } }
		}
		else_if = {

		else_if = {

			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = saffron_kiln_croft demand = basic_construction_needs } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { building_type = building_type:salt_mine scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = building_type:salt_mine_improved } }
			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = salt_mine_improved demand = workshop_construction } }

		else_if = {
			limit = { building_type = building_type:sand_pit scope:pp_cplan_country = { can_build_building = building_type:sand_washery } }
			scope:pp_cplan_up_site = { pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = { type = sand_washery demand = workshop_construction } }

		}
	}
}

# Location scope: start the upgrade to $type$ where the market holds its construction goods ($demand$); where it
# does not, the window counts it as held back for them (pp_cplan_note_goods). The construction is the plan's like
# any building: the group's purse, the reserve, the ledger, a level the gold does not reach counted and saved for
# (pp_cplan_construct_scoped; its cost estimate is a new building's, the game charges the upgrade price).
pp_cplan_country_upgrade_to = {
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_goods_here_$demand$ = yes }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_up_try value = yes }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = $type$ why = 107 }
	}
	else = {
		pp_cplan_note_goods = { why = 107 }
	}
}

# Country scope: one level of $type$ in every owned location the group may build in, whose maximum control reaches
# the player's line, where no tier of the line $line$ stands and the location's part of the can-build check
# passes; the highest control first. Where the market lacks the construction goods ($demand$) nothing starts and
# the window counts it (pp_cplan_note_goods; in game 2026-11-10 a ticked Library did nothing where the market had
# no books, and the pane gave no reason). The construction itself checks the group's purse and counts a level the
# gold does not reach (pp_cplan_construct_scoped, once a location).
pp_cplan_country_public = {
	ordered_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			pp_cplan_country_site = yes
			max_control >= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_country_control_line
			NOT = { pp_cplan_pub_line_$line$ = yes }
			can_build_building = building_type:$type$
		}
		order_by = pp_cplan_country_control_here
		max = 100000
		check_range_bounds = no
		if = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_goods_here_$demand$ = yes }
			# the window: the location's maximum control in % (+ 100); a building
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_rv value = { value = max_control multiply = 100 add = 100 } }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_rs value = 1 }
			scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_noted }
			pp_cplan_construct = { type = $type$ why = 107 }
		}
		else = {
			pp_cplan_note_goods = { why = 107 }
		}
	}
}

# ---- Towns and cities ----

# Country scope: the ticked upgrades, the biggest population first. The gate is the rank's own: the rank below, the
# game's population minimum (the rank's allow in location_ranks) and no modifier that forbids the upgrade; rural
# settlements only from the player's population line as well; and the construction goods in the market. The
# engine's can_become_rank is not asked: in game 2026-11-10 it was false everywhere while the game offered the
# upgrade and the effect worked (it also reads the market's stock in a way that is not understood).
pp_cplan_country_ranks = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_rank_town }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				pp_cplan_country_site = yes
				location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
				modifier:cannot_upgrade_location = no
				population >= 5
				population >= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_country_town_pop
			}
			order_by = pp_cplan_country_pop_here
			max = 100000
			check_range_bounds = no
			# where the market lacks the upgrade's construction goods nothing starts; the window counts it
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_country_goods_town = yes }
				pp_cplan_country_rank_up = { rank = town n = 101 }
			}
			else = {
				pp_cplan_note_goods = { why = 107 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_rank_city }
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				pp_cplan_country_site = yes
				location_rank = location_rank:town
				modifier:cannot_upgrade_location = no
				population >= 30
			}
			order_by = pp_cplan_country_pop_here
			max = 100000
			check_range_bounds = no
			# where the market lacks the upgrade's construction goods nothing starts; the window counts it
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_country_goods_city = yes }
				pp_cplan_country_rank_up = { rank = city n = 102 }
			}
			else = {
				pp_cplan_note_goods = { why = 107 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: start the upgrade to $rank$ where the group is not saving yet and the upgrade's cost here
# (pp_cplan_country_cost_<rank>) fits in the group's purse and in the gold above the reserve (as
# pp_cplan_affordable does for a building); else it is counted as waiting for gold, and the first such thing of
# the pass is what the group saves for (as pp_cplan_note_wait does: the location, the cost, and $n$ = 101 a town,
# 102 a city in pp_cplan_save_rank_107, since an upgrade has no building type). In game 2026-11-10: construct_location_rank
# charges the gold itself, at once, and starts a normal construction that holds the location's construction slot
# for a year (a city two) and draws construction goods; where the rank's allow fails it starts nothing and charges
# nothing. So the gold is measured before and after, and the upgrade is booked (started, spent, ledger, test log)
# only when gold was really paid. The ledger entry is written here: an upgrade has no building type.
pp_cplan_country_rank_up = {
	save_scope_as = pp_cplan_site
	# the window: the location's population in thousands (+ 100); an upgrade
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_rv value = { value = population add = 100 } }
	save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_rs value = 2 }
	scope:pp_cplan_country = { remove_variable = pp_cplan_noted }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { pp_cplan_saving = { why = 107 } }
			pp_cplan_country_cost_$rank$ <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_purse_n_107
			pp_cplan_country_cost_$rank$ <= scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_free_gold
		}
		scope:pp_cplan_country = {
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_gold_before value = { value = gold add = 1000000 } }
		}
		construct_location_rank = location_rank:$rank$
		scope:pp_cplan_country = {
			pp_cplan_rank_charge = { rank = $rank$ }
			save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_paid value = { value = var:pp_cplan_gold_before subtract = 1000000 subtract = gold } }
			remove_variable = pp_cplan_gold_before
		}
		# booked only when gold was paid: the effect refuses silently where the game's own conditions fail
		if = {
			limit = { scope:pp_cplan_paid > 0 }
			scope:pp_cplan_country = {
				change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_spent add = scope:pp_cplan_paid }
				change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_started add = 1 }
				change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dspent_107 add = scope:pp_cplan_paid }
				change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dn_107 add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_hit value = yes }
				pp_cplan_purse_pay = { why = 107 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = pp_cplan_log target = scope:pp_cplan_site } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = pp_cplan_log target = scope:pp_cplan_site }
				}
				add_to_variable_list = { name = pp_cplan_log_107 target = scope:pp_cplan_site }
			}
			# the window's line of this location in the group's lists: the upgrade (no building: pp_cplan_log_rank names
			# it), what the group paid here, and its reason unless a building of the group left one here in this pass
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_log_rank value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_log_cost_107 }
				change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_log_cost_107 add = scope:pp_cplan_paid }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_log_cost_107 value = scope:pp_cplan_paid }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_log_step_107 } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_log_step_107 value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_log_val_107 value = scope:pp_cplan_rv }
			}
			# test runs (pp_cplan_ai_test, set by the console): the rule group and the location in debug.log, as
			# pp_cplan_construct_now writes them for a building (ppc plan-report reads them); an upgrade has no building
			# type
			if = {
				limit = { scope:pp_cplan_country = { has_variable = pp_cplan_ai_test } }
				debug_log = PP_CPLAN_TLOG_107
				debug_log_scopes = no
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = pp_cplan_wc value = pp_cplan_country_cost_$rank$ }
		scope:pp_cplan_country = {
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_wait value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_noted } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_noted value = yes }
				change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dwait_107 add = scope:pp_cplan_wc }
				change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_dwn_107 add = 1 }
			}
			# the first thing of the pass the group cannot pay for is what it saves for
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_save_cost_107 } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_save_cost_107 value = { value = scope:pp_cplan_wc add = 100 } }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_save_loc_107 value = scope:pp_cplan_site }
				set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_save_rank_107 value = $n$ }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope, right after construct_location_rank started the upgrade to $rank$: the charging decision, in this
# one place. It charges nothing, and that is right: in game 2026-11-10 (EU5 1.4.7) the effect takes the game's
# price itself, at once (a town 482.14 gold = the price less the market's price impact, the number the game's own
# button showed). Should a game update make the effect free, taking the "always = no" limit away makes the country
# pay the game's price here.
pp_cplan_rank_charge = {
	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		pay_price = price:$rank$_upgrade
	}
}

# ---- Urban rights ----

# Country scope, once a pass after the rule groups (no gold): while the rule is on and the country may grant town
# rights at all, every ticked right the country may grant (its potential), in the rule's order: the rights of
# [construction_plan_country] rights_order, the specialization rights, then the rest in the game's order. A right
# stands before the charter that upgrades into it, so a location that qualifies for both gets the stronger one.
pp_cplan_country_rights = {
	save_scope_as = pp_cplan_country
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_rights_n value = 100 }
	if = {

				has_variable = pp_cplan_right_upper_bergregal
				pp_cplan_right_potential_upper_bergregal = yes
			}
			pp_cplan_country_grant = { right = upper_bergregal }

			pp_cplan_country_grant = { right = municipia_privilegia }
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_cplan_right_mark }
			remove_variable = pp_cplan_right_mark
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: grant $right$ wherever a location qualifies (the right's allow, with the location as scope:target),
# the biggest population first, while the political influence stays at the amount to keep after paying. In game
# 2026-11-10: the raw effect ignores the right's allow and potential and the location's number of rights and
# charges nothing, so every one of those is asked here and the country pays the game's price (pay_price took
# exactly the price). At most one grant a location a month (pp_cplan_right_mark). A location that holds the charter that
# upgrades into $right$ is left to the player (pp_cplan_right_site_<right>): granted on top, the right and its
# charter stand side by side and both bonuses count.
pp_cplan_country_grant = {
	ordered_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			pp_cplan_country_rights_site = yes
			pp_cplan_right_site_$right$ = yes
		}
		order_by = pp_cplan_country_pop_here
		max = 100000
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = target
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:pp_cplan_country = {
					political_influence >= pp_cplan_country_influence_need
					can_pay_price = price:grant_town_rights
					pp_cplan_right_allow_$right$ = yes
				}
			}
			grant_town_rights = town_rights_type:$right$
			set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_right_mark value = yes }
			scope:pp_cplan_country = {
				pay_price = price:grant_town_rights
				change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_rights_n add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the place of every tile of the tab's two grids among the tiles that show (the country could
# use it, or it is ticked), so the grids wrap: pp_cplan_tp_<tile> = its place + 100 (unset = hidden),
# pp_cplan_tc_pub / pp_cplan_tc_right = the tiles that show + 100. Run when the tab opens and after a tick (the
# scripted GUIs pp_cplan_country_layout, pp_cplan_country_toggle); the tab reads only these variables.
pp_cplan_country_layout_do = {
	set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub value = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_early_council_hall pp_cplan_pub_show_early_council_hall > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_early_council_hall value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_early_council_hall
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_minting_office pp_cplan_pub_show_minting_office > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_minting_office value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_minting_office
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_library pp_cplan_pub_show_library > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_library value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_library
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_university pp_cplan_pub_show_university > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_university value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_university
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_hospital pp_cplan_pub_show_hospital > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_hospital value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_hospital
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_counting_house pp_cplan_pub_show_counting_house > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_counting_house value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_counting_house
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_wharf pp_cplan_pub_show_wharf > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_wharf value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_wharf
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_protected_harbor pp_cplan_pub_show_protected_harbor > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_protected_harbor value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_protected_harbor
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_dock pp_cplan_pub_show_dock > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_dock value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_dock
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_bridge_infrastructure pp_cplan_pub_show_bridge_infrastructure > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_bridge_infrastructure value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_bridge_infrastructure
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_pound_lock_canal_infrastructure pp_cplan_pub_show_pound_lock_canal_infrastructure > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_pound_lock_canal_infrastructure value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_pound_lock_canal_infrastructure
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_fortress_granary pp_cplan_pub_show_fortress_granary > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_fortress_granary value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_fortress_granary
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = pp_cplan_pub_sawmill pp_cplan_pub_show_sawmill > 0 } }
		change_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tc_pub add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = pp_cplan_tp_pub_sawmill value = var:pp_cplan_tc_pub }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_tp_pub_sawmill
	}
	if = {
